problem_observed: A preliminary inline GD-VLV plot used default GD-SB dimensions that were much deeper and longer than the valve, contradicting the stated recommendation to size protection from the valve envelope.
proposed_change: Require GD-ST/GD-SB support or protection structures to carry explicit component-fitted sizing parameters when introduced to suit GD-VLV, GD-B, or similar supported/protected components; otherwise report a sizing gate failure or placeholder state.
evidence_requirement: Focused design workflow regression tests and plot/report gate showing defaulted support dimensions are detected and explicit valve-sized dimensions pass.
